checks.name: Synthetic Home visual assertions and screenshot capture
checks.result: No page errors or horizontal overflow; wordmark text has 90% horizontal visibility with 10px top/bottom insets; desktop Home hero has 24px left/right/top insets at 992, 1440 and 1920px; Bootstrap icon font loaded; 2/3/6 action columns at mobile/desktop/xxl cutoffs.

checks.name: Synthetic two-way Voice Study browser loop
checks.result: Question, teaching and Reviewer feedback speech requests; editable synthetic transcript; confidence and voice answer path; typing fallback.

checks.name: Rebuild only connected-local frontend and retain backend/worker/data volume
checks.command: docker compose -p learningos-connected-local -f deploy/compose.connected-local.yml build frontend && docker compose -p learningos-connected-local -f deploy/compose.connected-local.yml up -d --no-deps frontend
checks.result: Frontend, backend and worker healthy; existing backend and data volume were not recreated.

limitations: The focused visual run covers Home at five widths; it is not a replacement for full-route, axe, keyboard, zoom or long-label acceptance.
Synthetic speech interception does not prove live microphone capture, audible provider output or all-language speech.
Google OAuth/Drive and production gates remain as recorded in docs/build-state.json.
